OptiLab 360 is a software-only, physics-accurate digital twin that transforms the traditional Newton's Rings experiment into an engaging, interactive laboratory. Students align a 3D optical bench, turn on a 589.3 nm sodium lamp, focus a virtual travelling microscope, read a realistic 0.01 mm Vernier scale, plot real-time
